returns.title: Returns & Refunds Policy
returns.summary: Most unused items can be returned within 30 days with proof of purchase.
returns.body:
Returns & Refunds Policy (mcp-retail-sim)

1. Window: You may return most unused items within 30 days of delivery.
2. Condition: Items must be in original packaging with tags attached where applicable.
3. Proof: Order ID or receipt is required.
4. Refunds: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5–10 business days after inspection.
5. Exclusions: Perishable grocery, opened personal-care/beauty sealed items, and final-sale clearance may be non-returnable.
6. Damaged/defective: Contact support with photos; replacements or refunds are provided at no extra shipping cost.
7. Process: Use the order confirmation to start a return; a prepaid label is provided for eligible items.

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.summary: Standard shipping 3–5 business days; express 1–2 business days in supported regions.
shipping.body:
Shipping Policy (mcp-retail-sim)

1. Standard: 3–5 business days after order placement.
2. Express: 1–2 business days where available.
3. Free shipping: Orders over $50 (before tax) qualify for free standard shipping.
4. International: Not supported in this simulator (domestic US addresses only).
5. Delays: Weather and carrier issues can extend delivery estimates.
6. Tracking: This simulator does not issue carrier tracking IDs. After checkout, use the order_id from place_order / get_order_details to look up the order.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: This simulator stores only synthetic cart/order data in memory; nothing is sent to real payment providers.
privacy.body:
Privacy Policy (mcp-retail-sim)

1. Purpose: mcp-retail-sim is a synthetic retail MCP server for demos and agent evaluation.
2. Data: Cart and order state live in process memory and are discarded when the server stops (unless you add persistence later).
3. No real PII required: Do not put real customer secrets into fixtures.
4. No third-party sale: Fixture data is not sold or shared.
5. Contact: Treat this as sample policy text only.
